title: Charlotte Retention in Care Study
brief_summary: The objective of the Charlotte Retention in Care study is to assess if clinical decision support systems (CDSS) that produce standardized alerts for measures of retention in care across clinics in the city of Charlotte, North Carolina have the ability to increase retention in care measures within clinics and in surveillance reports.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HIV-1+
* Any gender
* 18 years old or older
* Residing in the Charlotte, North Carolina metropolitan area
* At least a single entry in the EHR in the last 2 years
study_population: HIV-1+, males, females, transgender, ≥18 years of age, residing in the Charlotte Metropolitan Area and with at least a single entry in the EHR in the last 2 years.
